name: five-by-five
description: Log and review strength-training workouts with your private 5×5 account.

interface.longDescription: Keep your strength-training log in sync with 5×5. Read recent history, start Workout A or B, log reported warmups and working sets, change planned weights, check remaining rest, and save or discard your active workout. Replies use your saved results for brief coaching. Sign in to the website with Google and initialize or import your log before connecting the same account. Rest-time replies are text snapshots; the website has the live countdown. Optional hardware-button coaching requires compatible ChatGPT Work event tasks and may be delayed. The plugin does not diagnose injuries, analyze exercise videos, delete saved history or guarantee background phone notifications.
